The customer's situation: they cancelled or returned something and want their money back (there was only one charge). They describe it plainly.

Answer with JSON only: {"messages": ["...", ...]}

messages: Hi, I sent the router back last week. Could you return the payment to my card?
I changed my mind and stopped the order before it shipped, but the payment still went through. Please refund that one payment.
Package was returned and marked delivered yesterday. When should I expect my money back?
I only see one payment for this order, not two. I returned the device and am asking for that payment to be refunded.
Hello, I no longer need the router, so I shipped it back using your label. Please let me know when the refund is processed.
Order was called off, but I can still see the payment on my account. Can you send it back, please?
I dropped off the router return a few days ago and haven’t received my money yet. There was just the original payment, and I’d like that refunded.
Can someone check on my refund? I asked to stop the order before it went out, but the charge is still there.
The router has been returned in its original packaging. Please refund the amount I paid; I’m not disputing any other charges.
Sorry, quick question—I sent it back already. How long does it take for the money to come back?
I requested that the order be withdrawn, and I was told it would be taken care of. The single payment is still showing, so please refund it.
The device didn’t work for my setup, so I mailed it back. I’m hoping you can return the payment to the same card I used.
I gave the router back at the store this morning. Could you confirm that my money will be returned?
My order never shipped because I asked for it to be stopped. I can see one payment on my statement and would like it refunded.
Hi support, I sent the router back two weeks ago and still haven’t seen the money returned. Please check the status of the refund for my one payment.
I’m in a bit of a hurry here—the order was stopped, but the payment hasn’t come back. Can you please sort out the refund?
I returned the unit with tracking number ending in 4821, and delivery shows it reached your warehouse on Monday. I paid once for it and would like that amount returned to my account.
I don’t need this router anymore. I’ve shipped it back, and I’d appreciate a refund for the payment that was made.
The order was withdrawn before delivery, but I was still billed once. Please return that payment and let me know when it’s done.
Hello, I sent the router back because it wasn’t suitable. There was only one payment, and I’m asking for that amount to be refunded.
